sessionStart.bash: R="${AGENT_MEM_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$R" ]; then for c in "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/*/agent-mem "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/_direct/agent-mem; do [ -f "$c/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ] && grep -q '"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"agent-mem"' "$c/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null && R="$c" && break; done; fi; [ -n "$R" ] && exec "$R/scripts/inject-memory.sh" || exit 0
